keep.action: Purchase a qualifying paid topping before the applicable 180-day no-paid-topping window expires. The official lifecycle rule is topping-based; do not treat ¥250 as a universal minimum keep-alive price because available qualifying toppings/promotions can change.

routes.kyc: Mandatory identity verification using an accepted Japan credential path, including My Number Card, Japanese driver's license or residence card.
routes.payment: Credit card; current card-issuer/country acceptance should be checked at application time.
